subject: On-prem hosting: security alignment & connectivity constraints
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: James Park <j.park@steadfasthealth.com>, Maya Chen <mchen@steadfasthealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Nov 2028 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call notes — on-prem hosting constraints & asks

Thanks again for the time today — quick recap and the concrete next steps we agreed on. I kept this tight so the procurement and infra teams can pick off items quickly.

High-level summary of needs (Steadfast):
- Data residency: all PHI must remain within Steadfast-controlled VPCs in AWS us-east-1; long-term preference is customer-managed S3 + KMS.
- Regulatory driver: NY State & Fed requirements + upcoming third-party audit in Q1 2029; SOC 2 + penetration test evidence required for vendor onboarding.
- Isolation: air-gapped or logically sequestered on-prem option under consideration for CDE workloads; must support an HSM/KMS (FIPS 140-2) integration.
- Networking: no inbound traffic from public internet to the model inference nodes; outbound egress only to specific collector endpoints (allowed list).

Open technical constraints we captured:
- Installation window: outage window must be < 4 hours for initial agent install, install via jump-host/maint-window preferred.
- NAT/proxy policy: outbound-only via HTTP proxy — TLS interception currently used by your infra team; need to confirm cert pinning approach.
- Monitoring & logs: customer requires audit logs forwarded to Splunk (collector endpoint) and 90-day retention.

Actions & owners (agreed):
1) Redwood to provide a short preflight checklist and a minimal network diagram for Steadfast infra (attachment: network-diagram.pdf) — Owner: Grace O'Connor — deliver by Fri Nov 3.
2) Steadfast to surface SOC 2 type II report and any penetration test summaries — Owner: James Park / Procurement.
3) Schedule an on-prem agent demo (install + egress-only test) with your infra and our Solutions Engineering — propose Tues Nov 8 / 10am ET.
4) Redwood to draft an SoW skeleton focused on air-gap install options and responsibilities (attachment: SoW-draft-Steadfast.docx) — Owner: Lauren.

Risks we flagged:
- HSM procurement lead time (if a physical HSM is required) may push timeline 6+ weeks.
- TLS interception/certificate rewriting could break model telemetry; we may need a CA pinning workaround or proxy ACL change.

Please reply to confirm owners and whether Nov 8 at 10am ET works for the demo. If that doesn't work, propose two other 1-hour windows next week.

Thanks,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0112

Attachments referenced: network-diagram.pdf (1 page, redwood network sketch), SoW-draft-Steadfast.docx (5 page SoW skeleton)
From: James Park <j.park@steadfasthealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Chen <mchen@steadfasthealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Nov 2028 16:17:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call notes — on-prem hosting constraints & asks

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the concise notes. Quick clarifications from our side: 

1) SOC2: we will surface SOC2 type II (most recent) and our recent pen-test executive summary by EOD Mon Nov 6. Procurement will follow up on vendor security questionnaire (I've cc'd procurement alias).

2) HSM: our security team prefers customer-managed HSM for production; for POC we can evaluate Redwood-managed KMS as long as keys never leave our VPC. Can you confirm if Redwood's private deployment supports a KMS proxy/integration?

3) On the NAT/proxy point: yes, we run TLS interception at the perimeter; that will likely be in place during POC. We need guidance on the CA pinning workaround you mentioned.

Nov 8 at 10am ET works for the demo — we'll loop in our infra lead (Maya) and a security engineer. Please send calendar invite and dial-in details.

James Park
Head of Infrastructure, Steadfast Health
j.park@steadfasthealth.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Nov 2028 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call notes — on-prem hosting constraints & asks (internal)

Internal checklist / next steps from SE + Infra enablement perspective: 

- Grace: produce the one-page network-diagram (customer-facing) + minimal preflight checklist (ports, proxy, outbound endpoints, sample ACLs). Target: Fri Nov 3 COB.
- Lauren: finalize the SoW skeleton with two install tracks: 1) on-prem agent + outbound-only egress, 2) air-gapped install with physical media + HSM. Add an estimated lead time for HSM procurement.
- Aditya (me): confirm whether the private deployment runtime supports KMS proxy (we have a pattern that uses a gateway VM that talks to customer KMS over private peering) — I'll validate with Rishi and loop back by EOD Nov 3.

Prep items for Nov 8 demo:
- Demo scope: agent install (non-prod), outbound-only token exchange, log forwarding to Splunk, and verification of no inbound connections.
- Required Steadfast attendees: infra lead (Maya), security engineer, procurement rep (for contract sequencing).
- Deliverable after demo: short install playbook + gap list; will feed into SoW.

I'll schedule a quick internal sync with SE to rehearse the installer steps — Grace, can you book 30m tomorrow?

-Aditya
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: James Park <j.park@steadfasthealth.com>, Maya Chen <mchen@steadfasthealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, procure@steadfasthealth.com
Date: Fri, 03 Nov 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call notes — on-prem hosting constraints & asks

Thanks James — great. Calendar invite sent for Nov 8, 10am ET (we included a short agenda). Quick notes ahead of the demo: 

- What we'll show: non-prod agent install, egress-only connection to a test collector, and the Splunk log-forward example.
- Prep request (Steadfast): provide an outbound proxy test endpoint and a service account that can write logs to your Splunk index (test credentials) so we can validate log forwarding during the session.
- On KMS: Aditya flagged a KMS-proxy pattern as viable; we'll confirm exact network/peering requirements in the preflight checklist.

Attachments: network-diagram.pdf (one-page sketch) and SoW-draft-Steadfast.docx (skeleton). Please review and flag any redlines ahead of the demo so we can iterate quickly.

If procurement needs a timeline: for POC -> 2 weeks after demo (install + verification). For production with customer-managed HSM, add 6–8 weeks depending on HSM procurement.

Appreciate the quick turnaround from your team — see you on Nov 8.

Lauren
